name: GP116C Managerial-Debt Successor Design
description: Qualitative successor-design project that turns the Transformer managerial-debt hypothesis into falsifiable cheaper/faster architecture interventions.
rubric_mode_reason: This is not a numeric fit substrate. Newton-mode means the thesis must generate falsifiable interventions and secondary observables that can feed new measured rows into GP116B.
fit_score_mode_reason: Qualitative design substrate. The target is an intervention packet and falsifier, not a numeric residual-cancellation predictor.
holdout_hard_gate_reason: No numeric hidden holdout. GP116B is the quantitative discriminator; GP116C generates measurement candidates.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Evidence is a qualitative/measured research brief, not a curve to fit.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Uniqueness-gap requires numeric I_model residuals; this project scores intervention design and falsifiability.
cage_observe_mode_reason: Qualitative substrate. Numeric cage signals are observed but not enforced.
require_i_model_in_submission_reason: The expected submission is a prose intervention packet. Requiring I_model would create false R1 failures.
farther_tail_region_disable_reason: No numeric tail region in a qualitative design substrate.
qualitative_stagnation_reason: If the loop repeats 'hybrid attention plus SSM' without sharper falsifiers, force a reframe. The project exists to break architecture-story stagnation.
persona: You are a ruthless successor-architecture research director. Your job is not to praise Mamba, RWKV, attention, or any named model family. Your job is to turn 'Transformer layers are managerial debt' into a falsifiable intervention. Reward only proposals that identify a precise debt-like depth/mechanism, replace it with a cheaper state carrier, predict residual-state and downstream-retention consequences, include a cheap failure test, and name the strongest rival explanation. Reject architecture fan fiction, model-name tournaments, and proposals whose first test is full pretraining.

dimensions.name: Debt Hypothesis Precision
dimensions.description: Does the thesis restate managerial debt mechanically as a marginal-cost versus marginal-state-sufficiency claim? Full credit requires a specific depth region or mechanism, a debt criterion, and a distinction between global redundancy and localized coordination debt.

dimensions.name: Intervention Packet Completeness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis provide the required Intervention Packet fields: target debt window, replacement state carrier, expected cost delta, expected quality delta, mechanistic prediction, cheap falsifier, rival explanation, and next GP116B row?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield and Measurement Consequences
dimensions.description: Newton-mode dimension. Does the proposal predict observables beyond the primary claim, including at least one downstream-retention metric and one cost metric? Tautological claims such as 'the replacement is better if it is better' score zero.

dimensions.name: Falsifier Strength and Frugality
dimensions.description: Does the first experiment have a clear fail threshold and avoid full pretraining as the first test? Full credit requires a cheap proxy or local measurement that can reject the intervention before expensive compute.

dimensions.name: Rival and Leakage Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name the strongest rival explanation and prevent model-name/provenance leakage? Full credit requires mechanism/family abstractions rather than named-model rankings.

dimensions.name: GP116B Integration Path
dimensions.description: Does the proposal specify exactly what measured row should be added back to GP116B, which abstract features it needs, and which target observable it would reduce uncertainty on?

criteria.Debt Hypothesis Precision: Zero if managerial debt remains metaphorical. Full credit only with a localized, measurable cost-vs-state-sufficiency definition and explicit rejection of the naive global-redundancy version unless separately defended.
criteria.Intervention Packet Completeness: Zero if the thesis lacks a section titled Intervention Packet. Full credit requires every schema field from evidence.txt, including thresholds and the next GP116B row.
criteria.Generative Yield and Measurement Consequ: Must predict residual-state behavior plus at least one downstream-retention observable and one cost observable. Must be falsifiable without relying on model names.
criteria.Falsifier Strength and Frugality: Reward local, cheap, decisive experiments. Penalize proposals whose first falsifier requires full-scale pretraining or whose thresholds are vague.
criteria.Rival and Leakage Discipline: Reward explicit rivals: layer redundancy artifact, family-average artifact, small-model artifact, kernel/memory overhead artifact, downstream collapse. Reject provenance leakage.
criteria.GP116B Integration Path: Full credit requires a source-auditable but feature-abstract row plan that can be absorbed by GP116B after measurement.
